BiblicalUsage: Jishvah is Ishuah, an Israelite, a son of Asher. In Genesis 46:17, Ishuah, and Isui. The fuller story is told on the Ishuah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ishuah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
